deltas.detail: Implemented: parses and canonically prints authored GraphIR 3.0.0; GraphIR 2 enters only through the named upstream migration.
Implemented: round-trips absolute and identified absolute/relative routeIntent waypoints without emitting retired routingPoints.
Implemented: supports relative, boundary, arrangement, required/preferred, and identified constraint forms.
Implemented: preserves node and edge label placement and reports explicit execution refusal where placement is unsupported.

Implemented: retains the prior portable authored field set on GraphIR 3, prints expressible relationship ends compactly (including nav/nonav) and empty, unspecified-navigability, or beyond-safe-integer ends through data.sourceEnd/targetEnd, and emits attributable diagnostics for successor semantics not expressible by graph-interchange-v1 syntax.

Implemented: uml-class notation derives the exact GraphIR UML class profile and round-trips structured class, interface, and enum classifiers with bounded compartments, members, modifiers, and identities; Mermaid class input maps through the same canonical model.

Implemented: uml-sequence notation derives the exact GraphIR UML sequence profile and interaction from declaration order and round-trips participants, sync/async/return messages, activations, target-associated notes, and flat loop/alt/opt fragments in one canonical order; the finite coral-mermaid-sequence@0.2.6 subset maps to the same model and refuses everything else.
Implemented: preserves an absent label instead of synthesizing the node id.
Implemented: resolves exact IDs before unique labels and diagnoses unresolved or ambiguous references at exact authored UTF-16 token ranges independently of sourceInfo.
Implemented: rejects non-string labels, extra relation tokens, and empty attribute entries.
Implemented: accepts finite JSON exponent notation for node positions and waypoints.
Implemented: uses exact ECMAScript NumberToString-compatible coordinate serialization with normalized exponents.
Implemented: parses bare null edge attributes as JSON null.
Implemented removal: a reserved underscore key in a node body, an edge attribute, or edge data.properties is a positioned error and is not stored.
Implemented: rejects pinned nodes that lack an authored position.
Implemented: rejects unknown escapes consistently in ordinary strings and body properties.
Implemented: an empty or duplicate explicit node or edge ID is a positioned error; the derived ID is kept only so later references resolve.
Implemented removal: the Language 0.2 equals separator in an edge attribute or constraint parameter is a positioned error that names the colon spelling.
Implemented removal: @graph layoutOptions.algorithmOptions is a positioned error and layoutOptions is not stored; the printer keeps reporting a programmatic value as coral.print.field.unsupported.
Syntax-only declared subsets have their own corpus; graph fixtures do not assert native support or semantic/operation capability.

The production notation reference advertises only enabled saved-source edition 0.2.8 headers and bounded declarations; tests read its UML class example through the installed reader. It does not certify arbitrary generated source, full language coverage or operation support.
MCP uses operation-specific source and interchange adapters; no universal semantic or export claim follows from parser admission.

Implemented on the 0.2.8 branch: the saved-source header and body scanners and the graph-only interchange reader accept only ASCII space or tab as token separators. Unicode whitespace and invisible format characters outside quoted text and comments receive exact UTF-16 coral.syntax.spacing.invalid or header.spacing.invalid findings. Runtime/native Tree-sitter parity, editor save/reopen, and MCP source-validation checks cover this boundary; Unicode inside quoted text remains valid except for literal line separators and control characters.
Editor notation allowlists are consumer validation and do not narrow core language syntax.
